description: The B018 accessibility, mobile, performance, resilience and launch polish manifest: every conformance check mapped to the surface that OWNS the behavior it asserts. The TL uses this at every future intake — a change to a listed surface re-runs the mapped checks.

legend.status: pass = green at the recorded run; known-defect = the check encodes a discovered defect as a characterization tripwire (fails the moment the defect is fixed, forcing the strict expectation); env-dependent = requires the host to provide Playwright + Chromium (self-skips otherwise).
legend.layers: composition = in-process composition + static markup (always runs); served = HTTP against the runner-booted next start; browser = real headless Chromium measurement.

checks.title: Focus management: keyboard navigation works across all interactive elements with logical tab order
Screen reader support: semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy and ARIA landmarks
Color contrast: minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text across all components
Form accessibility: all form inputs have proper labels and error states
Reduced motion support: respects prefers-reduced-motion media query
Live regions: dynamic content updates announced to screen readers
Responsive navigation: bottom nav on mobile (390px), side rail on desktop (1280px)
Touch targets: all interactive elements meet 44x44px minimum size
Responsive grid: content reflows appropriately across all breakpoints
Mobile layout: bottom sheet for mobile, modal for desktop
Viewport configuration: proper viewport meta tag and responsive design tokens
Touch gesture support: tap, swipe, and long-press gesture handling
Performance budgets: steady-baseline load shape meets all SLOs (availability ≥ 0.995, latency ratio ≥ 0.95)
checks.ownerSurface: tests/performance (A036 PERF1.0 extended for B018 product budgets)

checks.title: Adversarial performance: malformed requests breach availability budget → suite FAILS (fail-closed)
checks.ownerSurface: tests/performance (A036 PERF1.0 extended for B018 product budgets)

checks.title: Reproducibility: same (shape, seed) → identical outcome sequence and identical evidence digest
checks.ownerSurface: tests/performance (A036 PERF1.0 extended for B018 product budgets)

checks.title: Performance evidence: wall-clock recorded but never asserted; digest excludes timing
checks.ownerSurface: tests/performance (A036 PERF1.0 extended for B018 product budgets)

checks.title: Error recovery: global error boundaries catch React component errors
Loading states: skeleton screens and progress indicators for all async operations
Empty states: contextual messaging and actionable next steps for empty content
Network error handling: graceful degradation when network unavailable
Auto-save: work automatically saved during use with recovery options
Visual regression: viewport/responsive variation does not violate architecture markup shape
checks.ownerSurface: packages/ui-platform/src/styles (B001 responsive shell) + apps/web/src/** table markup (B007-B017)
checks.finding: UI-VIS-01: mobile-only overflow in demo surfaces (741px, 875px, 840px, 684px, 826px, 472px, 394px) due to missing overflow-x: auto on table scroll-region classes. Encoded as characterization tripwire: the battery asserts the defect's presence and FAILS when surfaces are fixed, forcing the strict expectation. Proposed root fix (TL-owned surfaces): overflow-x: auto on table scroll-region classes in packages/ui-platform/src/styles/components.css + overflow-wrap: anywhere on demo-banner hash code.

checks.title: Static overflow-safety: minmax(0,1fr) shell grids, no fixed CSS width > 390px, three breakpoints
Responsive shell switches zones (bottom-nav at 390, rail at 1280); keyboard reaches real interactive elements
Accessibility statement: published conformance status and contact information
Mobile support statement: documented capabilities and limitations
Performance budget: documented budgets and monitoring approach
Resilience documentation: error handling and recovery procedures
Launch polish checklist: comprehensive review of all quality gates
Cockpit screen: role switcher accessible, navigation landmarks present, truth labels properly categorized
Capability screen: case details accessible, task list navigable, status indicators properly labeled
Expert screen: workbench accessible, assignment list navigable, evidence section properly structured
Evaluation screen: results accessible, verification section properly labeled, certification badges distinct
Cockpit screen: responsive layout, bottom nav on mobile, touch-friendly controls
Capability screen: responsive grid, mobile-optimized table, touch-friendly buttons
Expert screen: mobile bottom sheet, responsive layout, touch targets adequate
Evaluation screen: responsive charts, mobile-optimized text, responsive modal

notes: The B018 battery extends the B017 manifest pattern with new a11y and responsive layers, performance extensions for product-shaped budgets, resilience checks for error recovery, and comprehensive launch documentation.
All new surfaces are owned by B018 and follow the established patterns from B017 composition/served/browser layer model.

The UI-VIS-01 known-defect mirrors B017's UX-VIEWPORT-01 pattern - the defects live on forbidden surfaces (packages/ui-platform CSS + apps/web table markup), so B018 records them as tripwires and proposes the root fix for TL intake.
Performance testing extends A036 PERF1.0 with product-shaped budget assertions while maintaining the deterministic house style.
Launch documentation provides comprehensive coverage of all B018 acceptance criteria for the B019 launch gate.
